_comment: Everything the emulation tier needs that this repository does not contain, named by
the exact bytes it must be rather than by a version that can be republished. A digest
is what makes the fetch reproducible; a version number is not, and a copy checked into
the tree would carry a licence this repository does not hold. See ../README.md.
Renode is the emulator this tier is committed to. It is distributed as a portable
build per platform, so a platform is picked by what the provisioning script finds
The register description is ST's, redistributed by the cmsis-svd project. It is pinned
to a commit rather than to a branch, and its licence file is fetched alongside it
because ST's terms require every copy to carry the notice.
